source: SEDEMA Ciudad de México: Árboles Patrimoniales
designation: Árbol Patrimonial, declared by the Ciudad de México environment secretariat for historical, environmental or cultural value; the programme's own bar is roughly 20 m tall and 100 years old
licence_proof: No licence appears on the programme site or beside the data file. The GeoJSON is served openly from the public map with no access control, but that is not a licence. Recorded as UNRESOLVED: usable as a lead list under the same standing hard rule 1 gives any third-party compilation, and a licence ask is the route to importing it as a register.
attribution: Secretaría del Medio Ambiente, Ciudad de México, extract of 2026-08-16
scope: All 13 trees declared to date, across 5 boroughs. Ten are ahuehuetes (Taxodium mucronatum), plus one laurel and one ash. The programme is open for nominations, so this grows.
caveat: UNIT TRAP, and it is the one the corpus warns about: Altura_total_m, Ancho_de_copa_eje_mayor_m and Largo_de_copa_eje_menor_m are labelled metres and hold CENTIMETRES. 2200 in the height column is a 22 m tree. height_m here is converted and height_raw keeps the original so nobody has to trust the conversion blind. Condicion_general is a real vitality field ('Declinante incipiente' on the Tacuba ahuehuete). Edad_estimada_anos is null on every row, so the ages quoted in press coverage are not in the data.
